sources.title: Austin Home Prices Drop Sharply as Buyer Leverage Grows
sources.startText: Fewer new homes hit the market than buyers might expect
sources.scope: Austin housing listing market, August 2026. Listing prices, not closed-sale prices. Longer listings and buyer negotiating leverage. Do not claim a measured social trend or invent exact prices. A locally recognizable Austin financial-life joke, not investment advice.
